resource.title: Quantum Physics I (MIT 8.04, MIT OpenCourseWare)
resource.access: MIT OpenCourseWare 免费开放：讲义、视频讲座（'Video Lectures'）、习题与考试，无需注册
resource.covers: 讲义按 'Basic Concepts / Quantum Physics in One-dimensional Potentials / One-dimensional Scattering, Angular Momentum & Central Potentials' 三部分组织，覆盖波粒二象性、薛定谔方程、一维势阱与隧穿、谐振子、算符与测量、角动量与氢原子、自旋（自旋 1/2 入门）。不完全覆盖：全同粒子与泡利不相容原理属于后续 8.05（其目录原文 'Prereq: 8.04 or 8.041'），本课只到自旋 1/2 入门

courses.scope_text: Experimental basis of quantum physics: photoelectric effect, Compton scattering, photons, Franck-Hertz experiment, the Bohr atom, electron diffraction, deBroglie waves, and wave-particle duality of matter and light. Introduction to wave mechanics: Schroedinger's equation, wave functions, wave packets, probability amplitudes, stationary states, the Heisenberg uncertainty principle. Solutions to Schroedinger's equation in one dimension: transmission and reflection at a barrier, potential wells, delta functions, the simple harmonic oscillator. Schroedinger's equation in three dimensions: central potentials and the hydrogen atom. Introduction to spin-1/2.

courses.prereq_text: Completed the following course(s): PHYSICS 61 Mechanics and Special Relativity 4 Units / MATH 51 Linear Algebra, Multivariable Calculus, and Modern Applications 5 Units / or MATH 61CM Modern Mathematics: Continuous Methods 5 Units. Corequisite: Should be enrolled in the following course(s): PHYSICS 43 Electricity and Magnetism 4 Units / MATH 52 Integral Calculus of Several Variables 5 Units / or MATH 62CM
courses.scope_text: Topics related to quantum mechanics include atoms, electrons, and nuclei. Experimental evidence for physics that is not explained by classical mechanics and E&M. Quantization of light, Planck's constant. Photoelectric effect, Compton and Bragg scattering. Bohr model, atomic spectra. Matter waves, wave packets, interference. Fourier analysis and transforms Heisenberg uncertainty relationships. Particle-in-a-box, simple harmonic oscillator, barrier penetration, tunneling. Topics related to thermodynamics: … Ideal gas, equipartition, heat capacity, the definition of temperature, entropy. A brief introduction to kinetic theory and statistical mechanics. Maxwell speed distribution, ideal gas in a box. Laws of thermodynamics. Cycles, heat engines, free energy.

courses.prereq_text: Completed the following course(s): PHYSICS 71 Quantum and Thermal Physics 4 Units / PHYSICS 81 Electricity and Magnetism Using Special Relativity and Vector Calculus 4 Units / PHYSICS 111 Partial Differential Equations of Mathematical Physics 4 Units or MATH 131P Partial Differential Equations 4 Units or MATH 173 Theory of Partial Differential Equations 4 Units or MATH 220A Partial Differential Equations of Applied Mathematics 3 Units / PHYSICS 120 Electromagnetism 4 Units or EE 142 Engineering Electromagnetics 3 Units
courses.scope_text: Time evolution equation for quantum systems and the Hamiltonian operator. Wave functions, probability amplitudes, and expectation values for observables. Schrodinger equation and solutions for one-dimensional systems. Quantization. Postulates of quantum mechanics in the language of linear algebra. Observables, commutation relations, and conserved quantities. Generalized uncertainty principle. Position and momentum operators and eigenstates. Separation of variables and solutions for three-dimensional systems; degenerate eigenvalues; application to Hydrogen atom. Spherically symmetric potentials. Angular momentum operators and eigenstates. Spin angular momentum. Spin-1/2 particle in a magnetic field. Addition of angular momentum and Clebsch-Gordon coefficients.

notes: 候选判断依据：N.1.3 由 MIT 8.04 目录 'Prereq: 8.03 and (18.03 or 18.032)' 直接要求（8.03 即本树 N.1.3 的振动与波课），另 OCW 8.04 大纲原文『Students must have completed 8.03 Physics III: Vibrations and Waves with a grade of C or higher』；M.3.1 由 Stanford PHYSICS 71 强制先修 MATH 51（线性代数+多元微积分）支撑；M.2.1 由 MIT 8.04 要求 18.03（常微分方程）支撑；M.2.2（候选推荐）由 Stanford PHYSICS 130 明确要求偏微分方程课（PHYSICS 111 / MATH 131P / 173 / 220A）支撑，故记 supported。M.1.8（复分析）、M.1.9（傅里叶分析）、M.6.1（概率论）三门课都没写成先修：PHYSICS 71 把 Fourier analysis and transforms 当课内内容，XJTU 量子物理只把概率论写成 MOOC 的“预备知识”（不是大学课程目录的强制先修），故都记 not_mentioned。补充线索（未列入 courses）：Stanford EE 65 Modern Physics for Engineers 的课程描述原文写『widely accessible to engineering and science students with only basic linear algebra and calculus through simple ordinary differential equations as mathematics background』，可作为量子入门课把线性代数与 ODE 当背景的旁证；MIT 8.05 与 Stanford PHYSICS 131 才讲全同粒子/泡利不相容（8.05 目录 'Prereq: 8.04 or 8.041'；PHYSICS 131 描述含『Identical particles; Fermi and Bose statistics』），说明 N.2.1 的“全同粒子”一项在本级课程边界上。
